{{Quote|It works. A little too well, to be honest. Pushes a lot harder when I run, throws me off balance. Still getting use to it.|The Mandalorian explaining his new leg to his friend while on Darvannis|<ref name="KOFTFE" />}}
An '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] who fought on [[Darvannis]] with other Mandalorian clans during the [[war against Zakuul]]. However, he lost a [[Limb/Legends|leg]] in battle, and it was replaced with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthetic. He was later seen talking to another Mandalorian about how it was working for him thus far.

After the war against the Empire was over and the Mandalorians became full members of the [[Eternal Alliance]], he and his fellow Mandalorian were once again working alongside each other on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. They were present at the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] when they saw [[Mandalore the Avenger]] giving the task of hunting down the [[Ash'ad]] to the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="KOFTFE" />
